name: Can Gio salt pans
kicker: Dry-season pans at Lý Nhơn and Cần Thạnh
summary: Salt pans in the dry season: walk a sunny morning from December through May. The fields run along đường Duyên Hải, at Lý Nhơn, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng. Most pans crystallize on tarpaulin. Go after sunrise, and save a rainy month for the creek.
dotReason: A morning in season, not the reason for the night.
getThere: Đường Duyên Hải in the town, or the fields at Lý Nhơn.
heroCaption: Salt pans at Lý Nhơn in the evening light

notice.title: The harvest is December–May
notice.body: The pans crystallize in those months, in about 7 to 10 days of hard sun. Outside them, choose the creek or the beach town.

body: The pans sit along đường Duyên Hải in the beach town, in the fields at Lý Nhơn, now inside xã An Thới Đông, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng in xã Thạnh An. Most of them crystallize on tarpaulin. The Cần Thạnh salt village is a traditional craft village, and you can join a salt morning.

The season is December through May. Crystals take about 7 to 10 days of hard sun. The area runs from about 1,200 ha in production to about 1,500 ha, and the production figure comes with a yield of about 80 tons a hectare. Go after sunrise. The picture is at dawn, and the heavy rake is around noon.

figures.caption: Cần Thạnh pans in hard sun, a different hour from the Lý Nhơn evening
figures.alt: A path between sunlit salt pans at Cần Thạnh

gettingThere: From the beach town, đường Duyên Hải is the town road. The Lý Nhơn fields are in xã An Thới Đông. Thiềng Liềng is a further boat, inside xã Thạnh An.
From Ho Chi Minh City, the road to the Bình Khánh ferry is about 50 km, about 1 hour 30 minutes to about 2 hours, then the town or the Lý Nhơn road.

legs.heading: From the beach town
legs.body: Đường Duyên Hải for the town pans, then the Lý Nhơn fields. Thiềng Liềng is a boat from the town.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to the Bình Khánh ferry, then the town or the Lý Nhơn road. About 50 km, about 1 hour 30 minutes to about 2 hours.
